parsed.faithful: ENDOWMENT, in law, denotes the fetting a dower on a woman : though femetimes it is ufed, fi- guratively, for fetting a provilion upon a parfon, on the building of a church; or the fevring a fufficient portion of tithes for a vicar, when the benefice is ap- propriated.
parsed.modern: ENDOWMENT, in law, denotes the setting a dower on a woman : though sometimes it is used, figuratively, for setting a provision upon a parson, on the building of a church; or the severing a sufficient portion of tithes for a vicar, when the benefice is appropriated.
